name: AlphaSense
summary: Market intelligence platform searching 500M+ documents, with an AI analyst agent.
description: AlphaSense searches more than 500 million documents, including filings, broker research, expert call transcripts and news, for company and market research. Its SuperAnalyst agent works continuously on research tasks, and add-ins bring it into PowerPoint and Excel. Plans are arranged with the sales team; a free start option is offered, and no public prices are listed. Content partners and industry-specific coverage are listed on the site.

howToUse.title: Open AlphaSense
howToUse.description: Go to AlphaSense and choose Get Started for Free. A free start option is offered, and plans are arranged with the sales team.

howToUse.title: Search the documents
howToUse.description: Look up company and market research. The index holds more than 500 million documents, from news and expert call transcripts to broker research and filings. The site lists content partners and the industry-specific coverage.

howToUse.title: Hand the task to SuperAnalyst
howToUse.description: Give a research task to the SuperAnalyst agent, or open the PowerPoint and Excel add-ins. No public prices are shown.
